notes.title: One room dungeon is now final form
notes.notes:
The journey of creating One Room Dungeon has been a great experience, and I’ve had so much fun building it with you all. From the early tests to community feedback, every moment has helped shape the game into what it is now. Thank you for being part of this adventure.

And here is 1.0.0 release note:

Added
・Improved Autoplay button for better clarity
・The final form of the final boss is now in the game
・A new skill system for Darklords, adding more strategic depth
・All bosses now drop unique relics for their minions, drastically bending the direction of difficulty
・Difficulty 5 – True Darklord Mode unlocked. It is intentionally not designed to be cleared
・Infinite Mode: A ruthless, nonsensical mode to test how far your dungeon can go

Fixed
・Ultimate count not saving correctly
・Skill level not saving (e.g. Daiji poison)
・Darklords’ equipment not being saved
・Shadow Clone bug where equipment effects applied to the original unit
・Potential Stone triggering on any kill
・HP 0 bug causing units not to die and freezing the game

Changed
・All healer units have been buffed
・Potion of Pride is now back to unlimited use – ideal for Infinity Mode

Current Game Content overview
4 Darklords, each with 4 unique skills
40 Relics
53 Enemy Types
26 Equipments
72 Minion Units
25 Potions
6 Unique Shops + 1 Default Shop

The game is now complete – but I’ll still keep an eye out for bug reports and feedback.
It’s been a joy building One Room Dungeon together.

Play the game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3065810/One_Room_Dungeon/]now[/url]

notes.title: One Room Dungeon 1.0 release date
notes.notes:
I hope you're all doing well.

I'm excited to share that One Room Dungeon will officially reach its 1.0 release on April 30, 2025. It's been a joyfull journey building this game with your support and feedback, and I'm truly grateful for the fun and memories(fun bugs and game broken screenshots) we've shared along the way.

With this final version, the game will be considered complete, and I'll be moving on to my next project. That said, I’ll still be around to fix any bugs that come up after release.

Thank you so much for being part of this journey. I hope you enjoy the final form of the game—and I’d be thrilled if you’d check out what comes next.

Take care and see you soon.

notes.title: Patched 0.9.2
notes.notes:
Darklords,
I owe you an apology for the serious bugs that slipped through at launch. I know it’s frustrating when things don’t work as expected, and I’m deeply sorry for the inconvenience caused. Your patience and understanding mean the world to me as I work hard to make One Room Dungeon the best it can be.

Here’s what’s been fixed in version 0.9.2, along with some exciting changes to spice things up! Let’s dive into the details.

Fixes:
Neocatz and Critbun Issues: Fixed the bug where these units kept attacking dead enemies. Now they’ll focus on targets that actually matter!
Counter-Attack Infinite Loop: Resolved an issue where counter-attack effects created infinite loops, breaking the game.
Dodge-Related Game Crashes: Fixed critical issues where dodge effects could completely break the game.
Death Animation Loop: Squashed the visual bug where death animations kept looping endlessly.
Game Freezing Post-Match: Fixed several issues that caused the game to freeze after the end of a match.
Buffs & Changes:

Spicier Enemies! Based on your feedback ("The game is too easy"), I’ve decided to crank up the challenge. All enemies, starting from the very first boss, have been buffed to keep you on your toes. Prepare for tougher battles and more thrilling dungeon defense!

Thank you for sticking with me on this journey. I’m committed to improving the game and making it as fun and challenging as it deserves to be. Keep the feedback coming—it’s the lifeblood of One Room Dungeon! Let’s make the dungeon great again!

Cheers,
Your Dungeon Keeper

notes.title: One Room Dungeon v0.8.37 Release Notes 🎉
notes.notes:
Darklords, it's time to delve deeper into the dungeon with exciting new features and changes in version 0.8.37!

🌟 Major Features
Dynamic Floor Events: Expanding your dungeon floors now triggers special events. Each expansion could bring surprises or challenges!
Floor Effects with Items: Placing items on specific floors activates unique effects. Strategize your dungeon setup to maximize these benefits.
✨ New Additions
Cinematic Intro Animation: Enjoy a captivating animation that sets the tone for your adventure whenever you start the game.
Multiple Shop Types: New specialized shops have been added, offering diverse items and services for your dungeon-building needs.
Selectable Target Unit: Most minions can now be directed to focus on a specific unit. Shape your strategy and dominate battles with precision!
🔧 Changes
Treasure Chest Makeover: Treasure boxes have received a stylish new look—because even loot deserves to shine!
Luck Redefined: Luck now influences critical chance in addition to other effects. Feel the thrill of those 会心 moments!
Level Cap Adjustment: The level cap is now set at 10, and EXP has been removed. Progression feels cleaner and more streamlined.
Get ready to experience One Room Dungeon like never before. These updates are sure to make your dungeon-building adventure even more enchanting. See you in the dungeon, Darklords! 🏰

notes.title: Patch 0.8.25 - MEGA FIXES + no reset ultimate
notes.notes:
Changes:
* Ultimate effects will no longer reset after the battle.

Fixes:
* Golden Treasure bonus now correctly applies to sell amounts.
* Fixed visual reset bug where items sometimes appeared out of the void.
* Buying a frozen unit now properly removes frozen visuals.

* Items in the shop will no longer activate their effects while in the shop.
* Earned gold is now consistently recorded.
* Playtime on the result screen is now shown in real-time.
* Dragging a unit with additional XP onto a level-one copy now correctly levels up the unit.
* Dragging a level-two unit onto a level-one unit no longer incorrectly applies level-up bonuses twice.
* Potions with no level-based benefits will start at the max level.
* Speed no longer increases with upgrades.
* Fixed multiple visual bugs with Space Friendship, including issues with hovering over certain units, such as the chest, which previously caused graphical glitches.
* Limited potions now target correctly.
* Speed on the pause screen will now reset properly.
* Level-up potions now trigger ally level-up effects.
Buffs & Nerfs:

* Bosses have been buffed.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.20 - new rules, new elements relic and improvement
notes.notes:
Exciting Major Update!

[list]
[*] Introducing Relics: Discover powerful items that provide passive benefits, enhancing your dungeon-crawling experience.
[*] Battle Changes: Post-battle, units will no longer fully recover health. Instead, they'll revive with 1 HP, making strategic planning crucial for survival.
[*] Miki's Starter Relic - Dungeon Core: Miki now begins with the Dungeon Core relic, which restores 12 HP to all units in the dungeon at the end of each battle.
[*] New Sleep Status Effect: Units affected by sleep will be removed from battle and will not recover HP during this state, adding a new layer of challenge to encounters.
[*] Random Relics in Expanded Dungeons: As you delve deeper into expanded dungeons, you'll encounter random relics to further enhance your journey.
[/list]

Balance Adjustments:

[list]
[*] Gold Rewards: Gold rewards have been reduced to maintain game balance and challenge.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where certain effects persisted on sleeping units.
[*] Fixed a bug where equipment triggered unintended "on purchase" effects.
[*] Addressed an overlap issue between shop items and the dungeon interface.
[*]

Hey everyone! Patch 0.8.1 is here, packed with exciting new content and improvements to keep your team-building dungeon experience fresh and fun! 🎉

🛡️ New Element: Equipment & Potions 🧪
Gear up! Now you can find Equipment to boost your units with stat increases or grant them powerful new abilities. Whether it's defense or game-changing powers, your unit load out just got a whole lot more interesting.
✨ Potions make their debut, offering one-time buffs or stat boosts to turn the tide of battle when you need it most.

💥 New Units 💥
New faces have entered the dungeon! Get ready to strategize with a fresh batch of units, adding more depth to your team-building gameplay.

⚖️ Balanced Randomization ⚖️


Jump into the dungeon now and explore everything Patch 0.8.1 has to offer! See you there, dungeon keepers! 🎮⚔️

notes.title: What is One Room Dungeon?
notes.notes: I created One Room Dungeon, a cute auto-battle, rogue-like inventory management game with a touch of Dungeon Keeper! Inspired by my child’s birth, it features a chibi style. Like my little one, it’s messy, full of fights, and bursting with charm. 🌟😊 Don’t miss the Steam page announcement! 🎉
